description: Quake III Arena (id Software 1999, retail CD v1.11, via Proton)
long: Quake III Arena is a 1999 multiplayer-focused first-person shooter built around fast, competitive arena combat. It strips away a traditional campaign in favor of deathmatch and tournament modes against human players or bots. The game is a cornerstone of competitive online FPS play, known for its movement mechanics and weapon balance.
